description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of the website service.
> The domain name must have a website forwarding rule configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

description.zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or half hour.
The number of entries to return.

description.zh:
服务地域。取值：
- **cn**：中国内地。
- **cn-hongkong**：非中国内地。
description.en:
The region of the service. Valid values:
- **cn**: the Chinese mainland.
- **cn-hongkong**: outside the Chinese mainland.

description.zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or half hour.

title.en: Query top user-Agents for a website

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-top-user-agent --biz-region cn --domain www.example.com --start-time 1609430400 --end-time 1708352700 --limit 20 --query-type example-string --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
